name: Ratten Reich - Dance of Kings
source:
Ratten Reich - Dance of Kings is a game set in the Ratten Reich universe. Through choices in dialogues and actions, an exciting interactive story in the world of Ratten Reich will open before the player.

The world of RR is immersed in a world war that resembles the first world war, and the main population is anthropomorphic mice, rats and cockroaches. The world of RR is inhabited by: rat militarists led by the Kaiser, who are driven by a thirst for power and expansion; unification of democratic countries of mice, the purpose of which is to maintain peace and stability; the empire of cockroaches headed by the emperor, which is going through not the best times in its history and is on the verge of revolution. There are two exciting stories to discover that will introduce you to Ratten Reich.

The first story is about a tanker and his detachment on the battlefield, the second is about two brothers who were spread out on different sides of this front. Your decisions will have a direct impact on the course of the story. The outcome of the characters' stories will depend on your choice.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Ratten Reich - Dance of Kings是一款以Ratten Reich宇宙为背景的游戏。通过对话和动作的选择，Ratten Reich世界中激动人心的互动故事将在玩家面前展开。

RR的世界沉浸在一场类似第一次世界大战的世界大战中，主要种群是拟人化的小鼠、老鼠和蟑螂。RR的世界里居住着：以德皇为首的老鼠军国主义者，他们受到对权力和扩张的渴望的驱使；统一老鼠的民主国家，其目的是维护和平与稳定；以皇帝为首的蟑螂帝国，正经历着历史上最糟糕的时期，正处于革命的边缘。有两个令人兴奋的故事将向你介绍Ratten Reich。

第一个故事是关于战场上的一名坦克手和他的小队的故事，第二个故事是关于分布在这条战线两侧的两兄弟的故事。你的决定将直接影响故事的进程。角色故事的结果将取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898010/]Steam[/url]]
